messages.author: swarm
messages.text:
BL-1494 — A note the post-QA branch sweep sends as deferred wakes its role at delivery anyway: BL-1361's ruling was wake only for a dirty worktree, its tell! sets SWARMFORGE_SKIP_SYNC_INJECT so the SEND does not wake, but handoffd's own delivery hop injects the standard wake for every new parcel, so each divergent-branch note costs the role a merge-up turn - 28 such notes to cleaner alone in four hours on 2026-09-08, one merge commit every three to five minutes, four or five wakes per landed bookkeeping commit across the pipeline; a note sent as deferred carries wake: defer and neither the delivery hop nor the chase sweep injects for it
What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-08 by the specifier alongside BL-1490-1493. Grepped
  first: BL-1361 (done) built the tell and the env-var deferral; BL-1421
  (done) the standing surfacing; BL-1191 (done) wake dedup - its 120 s
  cooldown and unchanged-mailbox rule do not cover a new parcel every
  five minutes; …
Approval context: A new feature file …
BL-1494 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1494" (or "reject BL-1494 <reason>") to act.
